request.description: Records a lender action. `action` is `acknowledge` (optional `lenderReference`), `raise_query` (`note`), `sanction` (`amountPaise`, optional `evidenceDocumentId`, `lenderReference`), `disburse` (`amountPaise` added to earlier tranches, never above the sanction), `reject` (`reason`: policy_mismatch, insufficient_income, high_obligations, credit_history, incomplete_documents, kyc_issue, fraud_suspected, borrower_unresponsive, other; optional `note`) or `note`. Sanction, disbursal and rejection always come from a person, never from automation. The first disbursal closes the application as won. Optional `expectedVersion` guards against two people acting at once. Lender context: admins and credit officers act, viewers read. Only files already sent to the signed-in lender's organization are visible.
